title.narrative: Air Quality Improvement in the Greater Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region—China National Investment and Guaranty Corporation's Green Financing Platform Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will establish a dedicated green financing platform for this purpose which will overcome the three barriers mentioned above (limited commercial bank financing, lack of incentive structures, and the lack of strategy for pollution control). The proposed Green Financing Platform (GFP) will introduce innovative financial instruments, recommended in the recently issued Green Financing Guidelines by China Banking Regulatory Commission and NDRC, to mobilize private and social capital for green investments. The proposed financing facility will offer a variety of financial products, which may include: (i) debt financing with limited recourse to fixed asset collateral; (ii) loss guarantee support to low-carbon development, energy saving, and environmental improvement projects for easier access to commercial bank financing; and (iii) mezzanine financing in the form of subordinate debt or preference share investments in promising SMEs, etc. This proposed project will also introduce international experience and bring advance technologies to the greater BTH region to help industries become low-carbon, low-emission and efficient green industries, thereby improving the air quality.

description.narrative: Air quality improvements and CO2 emission reduction accelerated

At least 5 million tons of CO2 emissions per year avoided compared with 2015 Achievement: 2140000000 Progress/Status: Achieved.
About 380 million tons of CO2 emissions per year avoided compared with 2015.
According to the data of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the PRC, the carbon emission intensity in 2020 was 18.8% lower than that in 2015. Data Source: Midterm review of the green financing platform in 2019 to check that the trajectory confirms the progress is on track
National and international data and reports under the Paris Agreement

The investment in pollution reduction doubles from 2015 levels Achievement: 798000000 Progress/Status: Achieved. CNY274 billion was invested in pollution reduction in the greater BTH region. Data Source: Beijing and Tianjin municipalities; Hebei, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Liaoning provinces; and Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region annual yearbooks
Midterm review of the green financing platform in 2019 to check that the trajectory confirms the progress is on track

Annual concentration of PM2.5 reduced by 25%; SO2 and NOx reduced by 15% in the BTH region Achievement: 15.2 Progress/Status: Achieved.
According to the report from Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the PRC, the concentration of PM2.5 and SO2 in the greater BTH region in 2021 declined by 18.9% and 15.4% respectively than that in 2015, and NO2 declined by 11.4%. Data Source: Beijing and Tianjin municipalities; Hebei, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Liaoning provinces; and Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region annual yearbooks
Midterm review of the green financing platform in 2019 to check that the trajectory confirms the progress is on track

Ratio of days with good air quality (AQI <100) per year reaches >80.0% in cities at or above prefecture level in the BTH region, benefiting more than 200 million people Achievement: 40 Progress/Status: Achieved.
According to the report from Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the PRC, the ratio of days with good air quality (AQI < 100) is 87.5% in 2021. Data Source: Midterm review of the green financing platform in 2019 to check that the trajectory confirms the progress is on track
Ministry of Environmental Protection report on Thirteenth Five-Year Plan targets
